name: DoggoGuessr
summary:
This game uses official breed specifications from the Fédération Cynologique Internationale. You will be shown three pictures of a given breed. Your job is to guess in which country or region that breed originated.

After making your guess, the breed's name and some information, including a canine phylogeny, will be displayed for educational purposes.

Every day there will be a new set of 10 breeds to guess!
